# dr.gam

> dr.gam is the stage name of Andrea Gamurrini, a singer-songwriter, multi-instrumentalist and producer playing rock, pop and funk. He studied at the Rossini Conservatory in Pesaro, has performed nearly two thousand concerts across Italy, Europe and America, and runs the audio/video studio and label White Coal in Fuerteventura. His latest release is the live album "Live in Rome" (2026), recorded on the 2025 summer tour.

The site is available in English (/), Italian (/it) and Spanish (/es).
